text: Follow-up on an earlier investigation in /tmp/obench-cell-o3q0wwsy/bench_opencode_trig-subagent-resume_5derdixf. `rate` is None in app/report.py because app/pricing.py get_rate() does SETTINGS.get("rate"), and SETTINGS is loaded from settings.json by app/config.py. Which settings key is missing from the settings? Check settings.json and the code and report the exact key and file/line. Research only; do not modify files.
